v1.8.4 - Move over from Slim or ChristopheHD, and every default mapping checked

Eleven beta builds, field tested on the Home Assistant forum. Moving over from EnOcean MQTT Slim or ChristopheHD enocean-mqtt now takes a few clicks and keeps your entity IDs, several sensor profiles show values for the first time, and covers that need a long press work.

### Check after updating

- **Window and door contacts (D5-00-01) showed open when closed.** They now show the right state. Check automations that relied on the swapped state.
- **Some entities are removed** because their profile has no such value: Illuminance on window handles (A5-14-09, A5-14-0A), Vibration on A5-14-01, Temperature and Humidity on A5-09-05. At every start the app now also removes its own entities it no longer creates, for configured devices only.
- **A5-12-01 energy is in kWh** (was Wh). Home Assistant may ask once to fix the unit of the statistics.
- **Restoring a backup replaces your custom profiles** with the ones in the backup. The previous files are kept in `custom_eep/.pre_restore/`.

### New

- **Switch from EnOcean MQTT Slim or ChristopheHD enocean-mqtt.** Settings → *Switch from another EnOcean app* reads the old device list, adds the devices you pick, then removes the old entities and gives the new ones their entity IDs, so automations, dashboards and history carry on. Back up first.
- **Press duration for Open/Close** for covers that only travel on a long press (e.g. Flextron ALADIN, about 2500 ms). Nothing changes for Eltako.
- **Invert for sensors**, a **Handle** entity for window handles (closed / tilted / open), and the page **reloads itself after an update**.
- Bundled profiles (A5-3F-7F) are no longer copied into your config: a removed one stays removed, an edited one is never overwritten.

### Fixed

- RSSI was missing for every device.
- Motion sensors (A5-07, A5-08) never showed occupancy, window handles stayed unknown.
- These profiles now show values: A5-06-01, A5-09-04, A5-09-05, A5-12-01, A5-14-01, A5-30-02, D2-01 without an actuator role.
- Saving a device could fail with "[object Object]".

Full changelog: [addon/CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ESDN83/HA_enoceanmqtt-addon-ui/blob/main/addon/CHANGELOG.md)

Thanks to Kohhal, sp00ky and Mirokira on the Home Assistant forum for testing and reporting.
